Tamil parties discuss alliance structure post-election

Several political parties in Tamil Nadu, part of an alliance that recently formed the government, met to discuss institutionalizing their partnership. Discussions included forming a coordination committee and a common minimum program. This meeting signifies efforts to formalize the alliance's structure and collaboration following their electoral success.
